decision: Close BINDER-MODEL-PILOT-1 with a scoped no-observed-difference result and retain its model, independently checked corpus, adapters and portable replay locally. Select RESOURCE-ENVELOPE-PILOT-1 READY and unstarted for source, validity and measurement preparation only. Existing audited positive-term/importer and supervision assets plus the real-proof pilot’s three fixed oversize, semantically unobserved selections make this a feasible preparation target. Do not treat binder Lean/Kiota RSS or time as comparable profiles. Keep the fixed two-family, six-size, two-observer matrix and require independent validity, comparable checking profiles, startup/import baseline accounting, measurement uncertainty, timeout interpretation and cleanup controls before freeze or launch. BUILD-MODE remains PLANNED pending a concrete supported configuration and input-influenced source site. No external write, successor execution, or assurance-milestone transition follows.

categories.assessment: The binder question is answered for its fixed finite syntactic fragment: 30,000 outputs matched across two selected APIs. The next useful distinct operational question is resource-envelope measurement; real-proof slicing found three oversize selections but did not observe their semantics. Resource preparation is feasible before measurement, while build-mode conformance still lacks a source-selected input-influenced site/configuration pair.

Retain the 10,000-row binder corpus and independent replay as a local regression package. For resource preparation, reuse audited positive-term construction/importer work and closure-control supervision patterns. The three real-proof oversize cases are evidence of payload-size boundary only, not valid measurements or semantic outcomes; select fresh valid size points and independently verify them.

No binder mismatch or target-specific defect was found, so no upstream issue follows. Existing Kiota and Nanoda follow-up remains on owner hold absent substantive maintainer feedback; ledger entries are dated observations and this review did not refresh external status. The selected successor is local preparation and authorizes no external action.

The prior valid-dependent-term result offers audited positive typed cases, generator/auditor and Lean/Nanoda import/checking bridges as reuse leads. Exact families, importer semantics and compatible checking profiles still need a focused source and reuse review for resource measurement. Binder-operation RSS and elapsed times are harness-incomparable and excluded as performance evidence. Build-mode needs its own exact supported-config and source-site review.

The selected item can remove its local preparation blockers without generating terms or starting setup: bind two valid families, six sizes, two comparable supported observers, independent validity, baseline/import accounting, sampled-RSS uncertainty and nonterminal process controls. Build-mode remains gated on a concrete source/config site. Independent transfer remains waiting for its external holdout dataset/curator input, and no local substitute satisfies that requirement.

candidates.rationale: READY and unstarted for preparation only. Audited positive-term/importer assets and portable supervision make source, validity and measurement design tractable. Preserve the two-family/six-size/two-observer fixed scope; comparability, independent input validity, startup/import baseline, sampled-RSS uncertainty and failure controls must be frozen and independently reviewed before any scientific byte or launch.

Retained as the next ranked alternative after the resource preparation item. No exact supported configuration/toolchain and source-selected input-influenced site have yet been bound, so an informative fixed matrix is not ready.
